value: I’m ambitious, relentlessly curious, and always looking for the next hard problem to learn from. I care about moving with urgency, doing things well, and getting better with every project.

I build practical software systems at the intersection of full-stack engineering, AI/ML, computer vision, and security. My work includes research software for microscopy analysis, adversarial machine learning pipelines, teaching support for core CS courses, and production-style projects using Next.js, Flask, Django, Firebase, and cloud deployment tooling.
